current.comment: Figma aliases this to toolbox/text/color so designers see a real color, but CSS must use currentColor: the tab inherits --lwt-text-color under an lwtheme and --toolbox-text-color-inactive in a background window, neither of which --toolbox-text-color tracks. Listed in figma-import.mjs's FIGMA_IGNORES so the alias doesn't overwrite this.
